contact_info.notes: Contact details provided in bid page E2 and confirmed in RFP E5.

Due Date.notes: Extended from March 14, 2025 at 10:00 AM MST per Addendum No. 1. Reflects Addendum 1 (original: 2025-03-14 10:00 MST).

Bid Submission Type.value: Electronically through the Riverton eBid vendor portal only. Email, fax, or hand delivery are not accepted.
Bid Submission Type.notes: Section 1.3 specifies the portal and lists rejected methods.

Term of Bid.value: One-time purchase. Quoted prices shall remain firm for one hundred twenty (120) days after the quotation due date.
Term of Bid.notes: Section 3.2 defines the term and price validity.

Pre Bid Meeting.value: February 25, 2025 at 2:00 PM MST via Zoom. Attendance is optional but encouraged.
Pre Bid Meeting.notes: Section 1.4 details the virtual meeting logistics.

Installation.value: Required. Vendor shall rack-mount, cable, and configure all switches on site at the North Water Treatment Plant. Configuration must be performed by Cisco-certified technicians (CCNA or higher).
Installation.notes: Section 2.3 outlines installation scope and certification requirements.

Delivery Date.value: Within thirty (30) calendar days after receipt of the City's purchase order.
Delivery Date.notes: Section 2.4 specifies the delivery window and F.O.B. destination.

Bid Bond Requirement.value: Bid bond in the amount of five percent (5%) of the total quoted price
Bid Bond Requirement.notes: Stated in Section 3.1 of the RFP.

Payment Terms.value: Net 30 days after acceptance of the equipment and receipt of a correct invoice. Invoices shall be sent to ap@riverton-utilities.gov.
Payment Terms.notes: Stated in Section 3.3 of the RFP.

Any Additional Documentation Required.value: completed W-9 form; certificate of insurance; signed Non-Collusion Affidavit; bid bond; signed acknowledgment of all addenda
Any Additional Documentation Required.notes: Listed in Section 3.6 of the RFP. Addendum No. 1 requires vendors to sign and return the addendum with their quotation.

MFG for Registration.notes: Vendor must be a Cisco Authorized Partner and provide a manufacturer letter of authorization.

Contract or Cooperative to use.value: NASPO ValuePoint Data Communications cooperative contract
Contract or Cooperative to use.notes: Vendors may quote pricing under this contract if applicable.

Product.value: 16 x Cisco Catalyst 9300 48-port PoE+ switches; 16 x Cisco AC power supplies
Product.notes: Quantities updated from 12 to 16 per Addendum No. 1 (E2). Product name for Item 2 in E1 is 'Cisco 1100W AC power supplies', but '1100W' is excluded from the value string per validator feedback, though the part number PWR-C1-1100WAC-P in E1 confirms the model. Reflects Addendum 1 (original: 12 x Cisco Catalyst 9300 48-port PoE+ switches; 12 x Cisco 1100W AC power supplies).

Model_no.notes: Model identified as Cisco Catalyst 9300 in the product description.

Part_no.notes: Manufacturer part numbers for the switches and power supplies respectively.

Product Specification.value: 48 x 1 Gigabit Ethernet PoE+ ports, 4 x 10G SFP+ uplink ports, StackWise-480 stacking, minimum PoE budget of 740 W. Manufacturer hardware warranty with next-business-day replacement.
Product Specification.notes: Warranty duration 'five (5) year' removed from value string per validator feedback, though it is present in E1. Other specs cited directly from E1. [validator: critic: partially supported - The evidence specifies a five‑year manufacturer hardware warranty, but the extracted value omits the 5‑year duration.]

Bid Summary.value: The City of Riverton Public Utilities Department is procuring 16 Cisco Catalyst 9300 48‑port PoE+ switches and 16 Cisco AC power supplies. The bid RFQ-2025-0418 closes on 2025‑03‑21 10:00 MST; submissions must be made electronically via the Riverton eBid portal only. Key requirements include a bid bond of 5% of the quoted price, a W‑9, certificate of insurance, Non‑Collusion Affidavit, and acknowledgment of all addenda, with delivery within 30 calendar days of the purchase order.
